data.one_liner: Lightweight reactive architecture and design system toolkit for Flutter multiplatform apps
data.what_it_does: Nano Core provides a reactive state system based on ChangeNotifier, a declarative routing engine, and a design‑system toolkit with themes and UI helpers. It also ships with AI‑powered MCP integration for remote architecture assistance.
use_when: Building cross‑platform Flutter apps that need reactive state and declarative navigation
When you want a single package that bundles state, DI, routing, and design‑system utilities
When you need AI‑assisted architecture guidance or remote MCP server integration
avoid_when: Very small or single‑screen apps that only need a simple state solution
Projects that already use a dedicated routing or state library like Navigator 2.0 or Riverpod
strengths: Integrated navigation, state, DI, and theming in one package
Declarative routing with guards and biometric support
AI‑powered MCP server integration for remote architecture assistance
Zero‑install IDE configuration for AI tools
weaknesses: Large feature set can increase learning curve
Relies on GetIt for DI, which may conflict with other DI solutions
No code generation support for models or routes
data.setup_notes: Add nano_core to pubspec, run flutter pub get. No build_runner needed. No special permissions required.
